page.layout: One page of text in a single column, with a running head and page number at the top. Below the text is a lone letter "A" in the right margin, at mid-page height.

main_text.p: quelque affaire, où ne leur fait point de justice : Ils ne sont point admis aux charges, ni aux dignitez, & meurent sans bonneur[?], & sans crédit, &c.A

page.notes: The first line of the text is a continuation from the previous page. The word after "sans" in line 3 reads "bonneur" in the scan and may be "honneur"; marked [?]. The "A" in the right margin is a printed signature-style mark. Stray ink dots and a horizontal rule are not printed text and are omitted.
